messages:
Anna D.: Heads-up — I found a few problems in the Console -> Observability docs while prepping the migration guide.

1) The cURL example under "Generate cost breakdown" still uses the old param names (no 'model' field). It fails on hosted v2 API.
2) The Python SDK sample for 'kv cache cost attribution' shows a different metric name than the Rust example — they produce mismatched dashboards.
3) The RFC link in the top note points to the old PR and 404s.

Can someone take the link fix + small snippet parity? I can do the dashboard query correction but want to avoid stepping on a docs PR if someone is already working in that area.

Markus H.: I can do the link and curl param fix. Which pages exactly? paste the paths and I'll open a quick PR.

Anna D.: Paths: /console/observability/cost-breakdown.md and /console/observability/tracing-hooks.md. The cURL block in cost-breakdown.md — line after the headers — is the one that errors.

Olivia P.: Re: parity — the Python snippet uses metric name `redwood.kv.cache_cost_v1` and Rust snippet uses `redwood.kv_cache_costs`. The dashboard panels join on metric name so the aggregates look wrong. I tested with a sample workload.

Lee W.: Small coordination note: we had a docs branch open (#docs/observability-samples) that touched cost-breakdown.md earlier today. If Markus is going to open a PR, can we either target that branch or coordinate merges to avoid conflicts?

Markus H.: Good call. @Lee W. — can you push your branch or rebase? I can open my fixes against it.

Lee W.: Pushed: branch name docs/observability-samples (just the tiny YAML frontmatter tweak). Should be safe to target.

Sam B.: I can own the Python/Rust sample parity part. I can make the SDK examples show identical query names and a short note about why we normalize names (backwards-compat for older deploys).

Anna D.: Awesome — Sam, for the dashboard query correction I'm attaching the quick PromQL tweak that makes the cost/latency breakdown match across panels. You can paste it into both language snippets.

Anna D.: ```promql
sum by (service) (rate(redwood_kv_latency_seconds_sum[5m])) / sum by (service) (rate(redwood_kv_latency_seconds_count[5m]))
```

Anna D.: And for the cost metric normalize to `redwood.kv.cache.cost.v2` in the snippets. Old raw metric can be aliased in Grafana but docs should show the preferred stable name.

Markus H.: PR: opened docs: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — includes: 1) cURL param fix, 2) RFC link -> new RFC URL, 3) small copy tweak. Target branch: docs/observability-samples. Preview: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai/console/observability/cost-breakdown.html

dev-docs-bot: preview ready — https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai/console/observability/cost-breakdown.html :white_check_mark:

Sam B.: I'll prepare a followup PR with two commits: (A) SDK snippet parity (python + rust) replacing metric name and adding a 1-sentence note, (B) add the PromQL sample Anna provided into the 'latency panel' snippet. Targeting the same branch to avoid merge churn.

Olivia P.: One more subtle thing — the panel description still mentions "KV cache write cost" but our runtime attributes split read/write. Can we add a short note about the read/write split and include the read-only PromQL (if someone wants per-op)? Example: 

```promql
sum by (operation) (rate(redwood_kv_requests_total{op="read"}[5m]))
```

Markus H.: Good catch. I'll add a short paragraph about read/write split in the panel docs and link to the tracing-hooks page for crosswalk.

Lee W.: Since there are 3 PRs (markus:482, sam: TBD, lee: small frontmatter), let's tag reviewers: @Olivia P., @Anna D., @Markus H. for tech review, and @docs-ux for copy/format. I'll add that in each PR.

Sam B.: Draft PR ready: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/483 (SDK parity + PromQL + note). Preview: https://deploy-preview-483--docs.redwood.ai/console/observability/cost-breakdown.html#kv-cache

Anna D.: Quick QA: Checked preview 482 and 483 locally — panels render, cURL now works with 'model' param. RFC link goes to the new RFC. One nit: the Python snippet uses an f-string that will break on older Python versions; please change to .format() to be safe.

Sam B.: Good catch. Updated PR 483 — replaced f-string with .format(). Pushed.

Markus H.: I merged 482 into docs/observability-samples to unblock sam. 

dev-docs-bot: merged PR 482 into branch docs/observability-samples — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/7a9f3b2

Lee W.: I rebased my branch on top of that and pushed.

Sam B.: Merged 483 into the branch as well. All snippet parity and PromQL inserted. Ready for final review: https://deploy-preview-483--docs.redwood.ai/console/observability/cost-breakdown.html#kv-cache

Olivia P.: Reviewed — LGTM for metrics and PromQL. Left one comment about wording for the panel title ("KV cache cost (per-op)" -> "KV cache cost and per-op split").

Anna D.: I'm happy to do the final merge into main once @docs-ux gives the thumbs up. Wanted to avoid merging before UX signoff.

dev-docs-bot: docs-ux requested review on PR 483.

Anna D.: @docs-ux — small copy tweak; CC'ing you here. If approved I will merge and backfill the redirect for the old RFC link.

Markus H.: Thanks team. Follow-ups: create a tiny migration note in /console/observability/migration.md explaining the metric name normalization to reduce confusion for customers doing manual dashboards. I'll open a PR for that next.

Sam B.: :thumbsup: I'll watch for that and update any SDK examples that reference older names in the SDK reference pages.

Anna D.: Closing checklist: 1) link fixed (done), 2) cURL example fixed (done), 3) SDK parity (done), 4) PromQL samples added (done), 5) migration note PR (Markus will open). If nothing else — I'll merge after docs-ux signoff.

Olivia P.: Great, thanks everyone.

dev-docs-bot: thread archived — no new activity in 7 days.
